Here are some high-quality YouTube resources to help you build full-stack projects and master the MERN‑stack (with React) alongside Next.js, PostgreSQL and Prisma—all ideal for someone dedicating 1.5 hours daily to side‑learning:

---

## 🎥 Full‑MERN Projects (Frontend + Backend)

videoMERN Stack Full Tutorial & Project – integrates React, Node.js, Express & MongoDB from scratchturn0search0  
- Comprehensive real‑world project — great for practicing a full workflow including backend API and frontend UI.

**MERN Stack Crash Course** (playlist) – bite‑sized sessions introducing each part of MERNciteturn0search6  
Perfect for structured learning at your pace with clear, digestible lessons.

**MERN Stack Full Course – Project‑Based** by Aniruddha Kudalkarciteturn0search12  
Focuses on project milestones and database modeling (MySQL + MongoDB) – helpful for understanding data design.

---

## 🍃 Next.js + PostgreSQL + Prisma

videoNext.js App Router, Prisma, Postgres: Your First Full‑Stack Appturn0search1  
- Deep dive into Next.js’s new App Router, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL setup. Great for starting from scratch with modern backend tools.

**Full‑Stack Blog App Tutorial | Next.js + Prisma**citeturn0search3  
Covers Google OAuth, NextAuth, and core Prisma patterns—helps with adding real‑world features like authentication.

**MERN‑Style Food‑Ordering App | Next.js 13 + Prisma + PostgreSQL**citeturn0search7  
Teaches Docker, React Query, Stripe, Auth.js. Good for full feature stack with third‑party integrations.

---

## 🔧 Quick Demos / Focused Tutorials

- **Prisma & Next.js Intro** – a quickstart video showing how to integrate Prisma and PostgreSQL on deploymentciteturn0search13  
- **Getting Started Prisma/Next/Postgres with Docker**citeturn0search15 – ideal for learning local‑dev setups and containers.

---

## 📚 Suggested Roadmap

1. **Start with a MERN end‑to‑end project** (Full‑Tutorial or Crash Course) to reinforce everything you’ve learned in React, plus backend fundamentals.
2. **Move into Next.js + Prisma + Postgres videos**, where you can solidify backend architecture with databases and ORMs.
3. **Build your own project** (e.g., blog, to‑do app or restaurant booking system), combining everything: React/Next, Express (or Next API routes), PostgreSQL, Prisma, auth, UI.

---

## ✅ Tips for 1.5h Daily Sessions

- **Set milestones**: E.g., finish setting up backend APIs by Day 3, database models by Day 5, OAuth by Day 7, then UI by Day 10.
- **Code along every video**—don’t just watch. Pause, type, tweak.
- **Mix short and long videos**: use Crash‑Course videos on lighter days and full tutorials when you have time.
- **Document each feature**: comment your code, write a README—this makes project review-ready.

---

### ▶️ Start Today

- **Day 1–3**: MERN Stack Full Tutorial (turn0search0)  
- **Day 4–7**: Crash Course & Playlist to fill gaps (turn0search6, turn0search12)  
- **Day 8–12**: Move to Next.js + Prisma + Postgres (turn0search1, turn0search3)  
- **Day 13+**: Launch your own project with custom twist

---

Let me know if you want guidance on structuring your project, adding specific features (auth, file uploads, payments), or if you'd prefer other playlist options.
